observations.says: the cook has him in her kitchen from eight till nine
the curate saw him through the kitchen window at half past eight
it was the carter who put him in the counting-room, and that cannot stand
the door was locked again and the key back on its nail: whoever took the bag went in with the key
by his own word the carter had the key and was in the counting-room a little after eight
the foreman was at his supper in the kitchen the whole hour
the counting-room lantern was out in the cart-shed: someone had been in for it
the carter's first tale, that he never left the forge, cannot stand
